anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
When the user switches workspace in the report view, which behavior should the new policy apply? The resolver at settings/resolver.ts:12 would own it, and ui/report-view.ts:30 would consume it.
A) clear all filters on every switch, so each workspace opens unfiltered
B) preserve all active filters across switches, so the current filters carry into the next workspace
C) restore each workspace's last filters, so every workspace reopens as the user left it
Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler already keeps active filters, so B needs no new per-workspace filter storage and existing users see no change; C would add that storage.

gauntlet: question
How should active filters behave when you switch workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves the view’s current behavior and avoids unexpected filter resets.
